newsitem.title: ITALY: Energy firm Enel's workers to strike on liberalisation.
newsitem.headline: Energy firm Enel's workers to strike on liberalisation.

text.p: Workers at state energy company Enel said on Monday they planned to go ahead with an eight-hour strike in protest over government plans for liberalisation of the sector.
The stoppage, called by the three main union confederations, is scheduled for Tuesday. But union leaders said it would not affect electricity supply.
The government in January outlined plans to liberalise the electricity sector and introduce competition in a privatised environment. Enel is due to be sold off later this year.
